notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS building a contextual in-app assistant + document search. Started on Hosted API trial (3 weeks), now evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency/cost and VPC requirement.

POC / trial highlights (hosted API):
- Start: 2026-02-05, ended: 2026-02-26 (3 weeks). AE: Maya, SE: Rafael on calls.
- Total API calls during trial: ~120k requests.
- Token mix observed: ~70% short-turn prompts (<=200 tokens), ~30% long-context workflows (500-3,000 tokens).
- Average tokens per request (trial): ~420 tokens.
- Peak observed QPS during load tests: 28 QPS for sustained 3-minute window; short spikes to 65 QPS during synthetic churn.
- Baseline concurrency during daytime: 4-8 concurrent streams; observed peak concurrency 14 during synthetic replay.
- 95th pct latency (hosted): ~230ms on average for short prompts, 420-750ms for long-context calls. Customer target: 95th <200ms for chat UX.
- Quality: Redwood model variant A matched baseline internal quality in 86% of sampled prompts (30 prompt eval set).

Customer production forecast (Summergate internal forecast shared 2026-03-04):
- Expected steady-state QPS: 35-45 QPS (US peak hours).
- Expected burst QPS: up to 90 QPS (marketing/feature launches).
- Concurrency target for Dedicated sizing: 40 concurrent generation workers (mix of short+long).
- Token forecast (monthly): 300M-550M tokens depending on adoption; working planning number used: 450M tokens/month.
- Mix for capacity planning: 65% short (<200), 25% medium (200-800), 10% long (>800).

Requested Dedicated sizing inputs / asks from customer:
- Provide recommended GPU pool sizing for 40 concurrency with the above token mix and bursts to 90 QPS.
- Show cost delta between: reserved capacity (commit 12 months) vs burstable dedicated pool vs hosted pay-as-you-go for mixed traffic.
- Need guidance on KV cache settings + batching to hit 95th <200ms for short prompts without blowing token spend.

Security / compliance notes:
- Must run control plane in VPC; customer will require KMS integration and audit logs forwarded to Splunk.
- Data residency: log redaction and retention policy asked by legal — retaining embeddings for 30 days only.
- Legal has flagged requirement for SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence and a short security questionnaire (answered 2026-03-09, shared in drive).

Commercial / procurement:
- Pricing sensitivity: prefer per-1M-token blended price under $X (customer gave target range in call — discuss with finance).
- Procurement: legal review in progress; procurement expects to sign on a 12-month committed Dedicated package if pricing delta vs hosted is <= 25% uplift.
- AE note: "They liked the hosted latency during the trial but need clear Dedicated SLAs and a deterministic pricing band to commit."

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-02-05: Hosted API trial kickoff (internal enablement notes in drive).
- 2026-02-10: Initial demo — in-app integration patterns and streaming.
- 2026-02-18: Load replay test against hosted (synthetic peak spike to 65 QPS) — observed latency spikes. SE seating follow-up.
- 2026-02-26: End of trial; delivered trial metrics summary.
- 2026-03-02: Fireflies call w/ execs to review results (ff_20260302_7321).
- 2026-03-04: Customer shared traffic forecast and token mix spreadsheet (drive link).
- 2026-03-09: Security questionnaire returned; legal flagged residency + contract language.
- 2026-03-10: Pricing deck shared; customer asked for dedicated sizing worksheet and example invoices.

Open questions / blockers (short):
- "How many GPUs for 40 concurrency with 10% long-token heavy requests?"
- confirmation on SLA terms for 95th latency and monthly uptime SLA in Dedicated.
- legal needs explicit data residency clause and KMS SOW.

Recommended next actions (AE + SE playbook):
- SE (Rafael) to produce Dedicated sizing worksheet with 2 sizing options: conservative (headroom for 2x bursts) and optimized (tight util packing). Include GPU type assumptions and expected token/sec per GPU.
- Cost scenarios (finance/solutions): show committed 12mo vs 6mo vs on-demand blending. Include expected monthly invoice examples for 300M, 450M, 550M token tiers.
- Schedule procurement call week of Mar 22 to walk legal through residency + KMS attachments; get verbal alignment on pricing band.

Short CRM-style notes / snippets from calls: 
- "Prefer deterministic monthly bill — CFO hates surprises." — VP Eng
- "If we can keep 95th for chat under 200ms we can go Dedicated." — Product lead
- "Need example SOW for KMS integration." — Legal
